name: cardiac_temporal_pilot_v1
scope: one pressure trajectory and one fixed geometry; contiguous time holdout is not independent geometry/trajectory validation
prediction: POD correction to old acceleration, then exact Newmark displacement update; causal u/v/a histories and prescribed next load as inputs
supervision: displacement correction MSE scaled by training correction variance, equivalent to supervised acceleration-increment MSE under fixed dt
rollout: start from exact state at test boundary and recursively update predicted u/v/a; report invalid Jacobians or nonfinite predictions as failures
